name: Requirement Gaps
producesProse: Open-decisions register with options and tradeoffs per gap, question backlog.

exitCriteria.describe: Every blocking gap has a user decision recorded.

purpose: Put every blocking gap in front of the operator with its options, and record what they decide.

method.summary: Register each gap with its options and tradeoffs, ask, and record the decision.
steps: Read the unknowns Stage 3 classified here and the requirements they block.
Author one register entry per blocking gap, with its options and their tradeoffs.
Ask the operator to decide one gap at a time.
Record each decision, resolve the question it answers, and revise any artifact the decision changes.
Set each recorded decision to approved once the operator has confirmed its wording.
Ask the operator to confirm the attestation, record an attestation against each exit criterion, then exit.

nextActivity.rule: Resolve a blocking question first; author or revise while any blocking gap lacks a recorded decision; attest once every exit criterion holds; exit only after attestation.
constraints: Do not decide on the operator's behalf; a gap they have not answered is still open.
A gap that blocks nothing is not raised here.

approvalBoundary.approves: That every blocking gap has a recorded user decision.
requires: The operator confirms the exact stage attestation or advance through Kiln's interactive confirmation channel during that invocation.

completionSummary.format: A concise Markdown handoff with bullets under Completed, Decisions, Open items, and Next activity.
includes: Each gap and the decision that settled it.
Questions left open, and why they do not block.
